description: Shared wire definitions for GainForest activity feed procedures. The feed returns references and selection metadata only. It never returns record content; callers hydrate the referenced records themselves.

activityFeed.description: Identifies the GainForest activity feed algorithm.

activityFeedParams.description: Parameters accepted by the GainForest activity feed. A request that omits params gets the defaults: filter all and following false. Anonymous requests need no viewer unless following is true, in which case viewerDid is required. Authenticated service requests use the verified issuer as the viewer.

filter.description: Which kind of activity to include. Reposts appear only when the filter is all.

viewerDid.description: Viewer whose current follows scope the feed when following is true. Required for anonymous requests that set following. When the request is authenticated, it must be omitted or equal the verified issuer.

following.description: When true, limit the feed to activity by accounts the viewer follows through app.certified.graph.follow records. Reposts are scoped to the account that reposted, and audio runs to the owner of the run's recorder folder.

recordItem.description: Reference to one project, observation, organization, or post record. It carries no record content.

kind.description: Which kind of record the uri points at.

cid.description: CID of the selected record version at selection time. Omitted when Hyperindex has not stored one.

createdAt.description: The record's own createdAt, which orders the feed.

repostItem.description: Reference to an app.gainforest.feed.repost record and the record it reposts. It carries no record content.

cid.description: CID of the repost record at selection time. Omitted when Hyperindex has not stored one.

createdAt.description: The repost's own createdAt, which orders the feed.

subject.description: AT-URI of the reposted post, observation, or project.

burstItem.description: One chunk of a run of observations by one account that are adjacent in the feed with no gap over 12 hours. A chunk covers at most 200 observations. A longer run continues in the following items, which have continued set and the same groupKey; merge them into one card. A chunk of a single observation is a burstItem only when it continues a run. Only a sample of the chunk is referenced.

did.description: Account that owns every observation in the run.

total.description: Number of observations in this item, at most 200. It is not the size of the whole run when the run continues in other items.

from.description: createdAt of the oldest observation in this item.

to.description: createdAt of the newest observation in this item. This orders the item in the feed.

subjects.description: AT-URIs of up to 20 observations from this item, newest first.

groupKey.description: Opaque identifier of the run. Every chunk of one run has the same value and no two runs share one. It is stable only while one client pages through the feed: it changes when a newer record joins the run, so do not keep it as a long-lived identity across refreshes.

continued.description: True when this item continues the run of the previous item, which has the same groupKey. False for the first chunk of a run.

capped.description: True when this item is full and the run goes on in the next item, so the run is larger than the chunks seen so far. Results are current state, so a capped item is not guaranteed to be followed by an item with continued set: treat continued as the authority.

audioItem.description: One chunk of a run of recordings in one recorder folder that are adjacent in the feed with no gap over 12 hours, whoever stored them. A recording without a folder is grouped by its own account. A chunk covers at most 200 recordings. A longer run continues in the following items, which have continued set and the same groupKey; merge them into one card. Only a sample of the chunk is referenced.

did.description: Owner of the run: the account in the AT-URI of the recorder folder, or the recording's own account when it has no folder.

deployment.description: AT-URI of the app.gainforest.ac.deployment folder the recordings belong to. Omitted for recordings without a folder and when the recording's deploymentRef is not a valid AT-URI.

total.description: Number of recordings in this item, at most 200. It is not the size of the whole run when the run continues in other items.

from.description: createdAt of the oldest recording in this item.

to.description: createdAt of the newest recording in this item. This orders the item in the feed.

subjects.description: AT-URIs of up to 20 recordings from this item, newest first.

groupKey.description: Opaque identifier of the run. Every chunk of one run has the same value and no two runs share one. It is stable only while one client pages through the feed: it changes when a newer record joins the run, so do not keep it as a long-lived identity across refreshes.

continued.description: True when this item continues the run of the previous item, which has the same groupKey. False for the first chunk of a run.

capped.description: True when this item is full and the run goes on in the next item, so the run is larger than the chunks seen so far. Results are current state, so a capped item is not guaranteed to be followed by an item with continued set: treat continued as the authority.
